description: Frame-independent formulation of B(deuteron), answering the owner steer. The frame-INVARIANT object is the total correction C = B/(μ₀ℏ_q[3]_q[4]_q) = 1.1015 (or B/μ₀ = 1.3652) — no tier split, no g₂, no t. A clean parameter-free closed form is B ≈ μ₀(q−1)[3]_q[4]_q (ℏ_q→q−1), err +0.77%. The HONEST frame-independent accuracy is the spread of motivated single forms, [−0.51%, +0.77%] → ~0.5%, controlled at O(h); the 0.036% figure and g₂=1.0087 are resummation-flattered (competing bar-odd resummations differ at O(t²)=O(h²), Lean-proved FrameAmbiguitySecondOrder), NOT frame-independent precision. So: the framework predicts B(deuteron) parameter-free to ~0.5% (20× over the naive q-Casimir's 9.2%); the real open target is C below ~0.5% by a DERIVED higher-order structure (the Δ_λ closure), not a chosen resummation. scope-(a), audit-only, nothing wired; no fit.
tier: frame-invariant reformulation + motivated-form accuracy spread + Lean-proved O(t²) frame ambiguity; answers the owner steer; no fit

frame_invariant_formulation.no_tier_split: C carries NO g₂, NO t — those are frame-dependent decompositions of C.

F2_honest_accuracy.controlled_order: O(h) — all frames agree through first order in t
F2_honest_accuracy.resummation_flattered: the 0.036% figure needs the SPECIFIC (1+h²)/(1−t) resummation; competing resummations differ at O(t²)=O(h²) (Lean-proved) — the same order as the whole bar-even signal, so 0.036% is NOT a frame-independent accuracy.

verdict.frame_independent_statement: the framework predicts B(deuteron) parameter-free to ~0.5% (a ~20× improvement over the naive q-Casimir's 9.2%), controlled at O(h).
verdict.g2_precision_is_artifact: the sub-0.1% accuracy and g₂ = 1.0087 are one resummation's frame-flattered residual (O(h²) frame ambiguity, Lean-proved), NOT additional genuine precision.
verdict.real_target: predict C = B/E₀ = 1.1015 below ~0.5% by a DERIVED higher-order structure (not a chosen resummation) — the Δ_λ closure, frame-independently.
